Maya (ml-eng): Quick heads-up — after the quant4b bring-up with long-context multimodal prompts we started seeing a spike in hallucination-style answers for image-caption tasks (>1200 tokens). Not just weird wording, but invented facts tied to the image.

Cole (research): ugh. Is that reproducible on the CPU litmus and on fp16? Any diffs when we run the non-quantized baseline on the same eval?

Maya (ml-eng): baseline fp16 looks much cleaner on the same holdout. I ran 50 examples locally: hallucination rate ~6% baseline, ~22% quant4b. Logs: `run/2026-03-18/quant4b-longctx.log` — there's a pattern around concat+image-embedding prefix.

Jun (annot-ops): tagging this as a potential data issue too — we discovered duplicated image+caption variants in the longctx bank. The vendor dedupe only removed exact text duplicates, not perceptually identical images with different rephrases. We should dedupe multimodal pairs by image fingerprint + embed similarity.

Saira (labeling-pm): Agreed. Proposed action: (1) build a 400-example golden refresh (200 longctx image-text, 150 short/adversarial, 50 multimodal paraphrase pairs), (2) vendor relabel with updated instructions, (3) run AB on baseline vs quant4b. Who owns the dedupe pipeline? :eyes:

Jun (annot-ops): I can own the dedupe prototype. Plan: phash -> cluster -> within-cluster embed-sim. Pseudocode:
```
images = load_all_images(bank)
clusters = cluster_by_phash(images, radius=2)
for c in clusters:
  reps = compute_image_embeds(c)
  pairs = pairwise_sim(reps)
  canonical = pick_highest_quality(c)
  remove_if(sim>0.92 and caption_jaccard>0.8)
```
Will push a notebook by EOD.

Priya (qc): For the golden labels, add an explicit hallucination rubric: "answer must be grounded in visible content or explicitly state uncertainty." We'll need a short promptset for raters that includes synthetic adversarials (cut/paste unrelated text, misleading alt-text).

Cole (research): For evaluation metrics let's not rely on BLEU. We'll use hallucination rate (binary), factuality precision, and a model-critic score (crowd rated 1-5). Quick AB plan: 500 holdout examples stratified by context length; run both models, then blind human eval on 200 sampled responses. If quant4b loses >8 points on model-critic mean or +10% hallucination, rollback.

val-bot: New job scheduled: multimodal-dedupe-proto (owner=Jun) — ETA 2026-03-18T21:00Z.

Maya (ml-eng): Also adding an explicit reproducer in the repo: `examples/multimodal/repro_longctx.py` (will include the exact tokenization + concat ordering). If dedupe + golden relabel reduces the gap, likely data issue; if not, need kernel-level investigate.

Saira (labeling-pm): I'll create the vendor ticket with the updated instructions and the golden CSV. Please tag the notebook when you push it. Timeline: dedupe proto today, golden-ready by tomorrow noon, 3-day vendor relabel, AB results by next Friday. :calendar:
